name: Oracle EBS Functional Consultant (Financials)
description: Oracle E-Business Suite Financials functional work: GL, AP, AR, FA and CE setups, period close, configurations, test scripts, data loads and user support.

concepts.title: Ledger = chart of accounts + calendar + currency + accounting method (the 4 Cs)
Chart of accounts: segments, value sets and the GL# key flexfield
Cross-validation rules vs security rules
Accounting calendar, period types and adjusting periods
Journal sources and categories, journal import and posting
Recurring journals and MassAllocations
Revaluation, translation and consolidation
Data access sets and the GL: Data Access Set profile
Invoice lifecycle: entry, validation, holds, accounting, payment
2-way, 3-way and 4-way matching and match holds
Payables options, financials options and payment terms
Suppliers, sites and site assignments (TCA)
Withholding tax setup
Prepayments and their application
Transaction types, sources and batch sources
AutoAccounting: where the revenue and receivable accounts come from
Receipt classes, methods, applications and remittance
Customers, accounts, sites and profile classes
Aging buckets, dunning and statements
Asset books: corporate vs tax books
Asset categories and the asset key and location flexfields
Depreciation methods, prorate conventions and running depreciation
Additions, mass additions, transfers, adjustments and retirements
Banks, branches and bank accounts
Bank statement load and import
Manual and automatic reconciliation, matching rules and tolerances
Cash positioning and cash forecasting
Payment process profiles, payment methods and formats
Payment process requests: selection, build, format, confirm
Tax regime, tax, status, rate and jurisdiction
Tax rules and the tax determination flow
Create Accounting, transfer to GL and the accounting events
Subledger accounting methods, journal line definitions and account derivation rules
Close order: AP, AR, FA, CE, then GL
Subledger to GL reconciliation
Unaccounted transactions, sweep and period status
Responsibilities, menus, request groups and users
Profile options and their levels (site, application, responsibility, user)
Multi-Org Access Control: security profiles and MO: profiles
Legal entities, ledgers, operating units and inventory organizations
Accounting Setup Manager
FSG: row sets, column sets and report definitions
Standard reports for reconciliation (trial balance, aging, account analysis)
Loading journals with Web ADI
Integrators, layouts and mappings

cvTips.title: Action, what, result.
cvTips.text: Start with a verb (Configured, Led, Migrated, Tested), name the module and the setup, end with the business result.

cvTips.title: Numbers win.
cvTips.text: Close days saved, ledgers or entities set up, records loaded and reconciled, users trained.

cvTips.title: Name the real setups.
cvTips.text: Cross-validation rules, AutoAccounting, SLA methods, payment process profiles. Recruiters search for these exact terms.

cvTips.title: Module and release.
cvTips.text: "Oracle EBS R12.2 GL, AP, AR" says much more than "Oracle Financials".

cvTips.title: Show the full cycle.
cvTips.text: Requirements, BR100, CRP, SIT, UAT, go-live, post go-live support.

cvTips.title: Keep it confidential.
cvTips.text: No client names, ticket IDs, internal object names or real amounts. Stranote flags these in amber.

cvTips.title: Keep it fresh.
cvTips.text: Check this page every month and export a new version.
